record.paper_title: Open Problems on Configuration Spaces of Tensegrities
record.original_question: Describe the combinatorics of the three tensegrity configuration spaces B_2(K_6), B_3(K_4), and B_3(K_5), where B_d(G) denotes the configuration space of all realizations of the graph G on labeled vertices in R^d and the stratification is by maximal connected components with equivalent self-stress fibers.

evidence.quote: Denote by B_d(G) = (R^d)^n the configuration space of all tensegrity frameworks.
A stratum is by definition a maximal connected component of B_d(G) with equivalent fibers.
Problem 1 Describe the combinatorics of B_2(K_6), B_3(K_4) and B_3(K_5).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite simple graph with vertex set $V=\{1,\dots,n\}$. For an integer $d\ge 1$, the configuration space of tensegrity frameworks on $G$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is
$$B_d(G):=(\mathbb{R}^d)^n,$$
whose points $p=(p_1,\dots,p_n)$ are placements of the labeled vertices of $G$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$. A self-stress on a framework $p\in B_d(G)$ is an assignment of real weights $w:E\to\mathbb{R}$ such that for every vertex $i\in V$,
$$\sum_{j:\{i,j\}\in E} w_{ij}\,(p_j-p_i)=0.$$
The set of all self-stresses of $p$ forms a real vector subspace $W(p)\subseteq\mathbb{R}^E$, called the stress fiber over $p$. Two configurations $p,p'\in B_d(G)$ are called equivalent if there is an isomorphism between $W(p)$ and $W(p')$ that preserves the signs (positive, negative, zero) of all coordinates indexed by $E$. A stratum of $B_d(G)$ is a maximal connected subset of $B_d(G)$ all of whose points are pairwise equivalent in this sense. The resulting decomposition gives the stratification of $B_d(G)$ by stress-equivalence, and its combinatorics consist of the list of strata together with their dimensions and adjacency relations.

Problem: For the complete graphs $K_4$, $K_5$, $K_6$, describe the combinatorics of the stratifications of the three configuration spaces
$$B_2(K_6),\qquad B_3(K_4),\qquad B_3(K_5),$$
giving in each case an explicit enumeration of the strata, their dimensions, and the adjacency diagram between them.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is explicitly listed as an open problem in the survey on configuration spaces of tensegrities (Arnold Mathematical Journal, 2018). Prior work of Doray–Karpenkov–Schepers describes the combinatorics of B_2(K_n) only for n ≤ 5, and no published description of B_2(K_6), B_3(K_4), or B_3(K_5) has been found in subsequent literature.
